dedupe_keys.name: melaudis a large scale benchmark acoustic dataset for intelligent transportation systems research

description: MELAUDIS: A Large-Scale Benchmark Acoustic Dataset For Intelligent Transportation Systems Research is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Hossein Parineh et al. Acoustic traffic sensors provide valuable information about road traffic at an affordable cost, gaining significant attention in recent years. However, the field of audio signal processing for Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) lacks real-world complex datasets. We introduce MELAUDIS, the first complete real-world dataset designed for vehicle detection, traffic status monitoring, and vehicle type classification. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 3724588054 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
